reviews.text:
My first visit was with the groomer, who took excellent care of my princess. She left with a beautifully shiny coat and perfectly clean ears.

The service cost €53 for my Labrador. Don't hesitate to call them to find out the price based on your dog's breed.

You can also buy various accessories, food, and supplies for cats and dogs on-site. The prices are affordable there too!

I wholeheartedly recommend Gwendog Grooming. I plan to come back every time; my dog ​​was very comfortable there.

Thank you! 🥰

See you soon!
Small salon but fully equipped. First time here, but I'll be back. Reasonable prices, even for those on a budget! Very gentle with our furry babies, and that's what matters most!
First visit for my cocker spaniel who needed hair removal and very happy with the result!
Our cocker spaniel has been groomed by this groomer twice already. And it's always been a great job. Thank you!

If you have an English Cocker Spaniel, I strongly advise against this salon. They promise to do a professional hair removal but ultimately can't deliver.

I dropped my dog ​​off there for a bath, hair removal, and detangling, and it took them three hours to make four passes with the clippers where her mats were too tight... but clearly not to remove the hair.

She literally had as much fur as before the grooming. Maybe they managed to remove a little bit of dead hair, but definitely not the undercoat, which is supposed to come off with a Cocker Spaniel hair removal.

Furthermore, when I picked her up, I expressed my dissatisfaction that they hadn't removed the hair from my dog's head, and they told me they couldn't because there might not be any hair underneath??? And that they would have to use clippers or scissors to shorten it... good luck if you end up with a shaved Cocker Spaniel.

In the end, I took my dog ​​to another groomer (Au Chien Chic in Argenteuil) the next day, who was appalled by the work done and who, unlike me, knew very well how to pluck my dog's fur and shave her head...😉

A young intern or trainee there grabbed my cat, ripped out its fur, and completely clipped its claws. It was a disaster…the level of animal abuse was appalling. She even dared to tell me it didn't hurt them. Maybe if someone pulled her hair, she'd understand better.
I'm increasingly satisfied with the grooming of my Exotic Shorthair Yorkie by Gwendoline. He came out looking like a lovely teddy bear. I highly recommend her.
Super
Very happy with my little Shih Tzu's very first grooming session. The welcome was very friendly and the instructions were followed. We'll definitely be back.
My official groomer for over a year now. And I can only recommend her.
Very welcoming
Why provide a phone number if you're just going to automatically reject calls? It smells fishy from the start, don't waste your time there!
Fantastic salon! My dog ​​is very timid; he came from a shelter. The staff were incredibly kind and patient. The result is amazing! Thank you!
I'm taking my two little Shih Tzu dogs there without hesitation!!! 🏅 …
Great professionals, kind and caring.
Second visit for my cat, still just as satisfied! Neat, professional, efficient work and reasonable prices. I recommend them 👍 …
Best groomers always very pleased with their services

After trying other groomers, I'm thrilled with my first grooming session at Gwen Dog for my Bichon Frise. They perfectly understood the desired cut, and the result is just perfect 😍 The price is very low for the quality of the work. …
Really very good. Very kind
Good service and friendly staff.
Excellent grooming salon. My two dogs are spotless. Well done.
Titus, our little dachshund, has a superb haircut! Thank you again!

Stumbled upon this grooming gem where, miracle of miracles, they had a slot available either same day or the next—which, let me tell you, is as rare as a calm day on the Paris Metro. Most places around here are booked solid for three months or just won't entertain new furry clients.

The staff was super friendly; the person who welcomed our dog, Cash, was thorough and detailed, explaining everything with the patience of a saint.
They even called me after I left to discuss different pricing options, which is a breath of fresh air because, let’s be honest, some places just slap the charges on your bill like a surprise tax.

We paid 66 euros for a full grooming session—cut, bath, and the whole shebang, lasting about 3 hours. That's a steal compared to the 150+ euros we've coughed up in fancier parts of the city. The only slight snag is the retail store you wade through on entry; it's a bit of a jumble of products and smells distinctly of dog food—but hey, it's a pet store, right? What else do we expect?

Overall, the experience was top-notch. I popped back in five minutes before Cash was ready and found him looking dapper, clearly well-treated, and practically grinning from ear to fluffy ear. He was excited to see me, smelling like roses and looking sharp.
Zero complaints and all praises for this place!
I left my Golden Retriever in for grooming. Completely satisfied, I'll be back. A great find, I highly recommend Gwendog Grooming.
Excellent service, dogs are very well received. A big thank you to the amazing team!
